title: Agency Banking Architecture Golden Benchmark
generationInputPolicy: The completed Agency Banking SDD is excluded from architecture generation and is used only as a post-generation comparison reference.
businessProblem: Enable a regulated financial institution to operate a secure agency banking channel through approved agents, supporting customer onboarding, identity verification, cash-in, cash-out, transfers, balance enquiries, reversals, settlement, reconciliation and operational support while integrating with existing core banking and payment infrastructure.
knownConstraints: Existing core banking remains the system of record for customer accounts and financial posting.
External identity/KYC and payment-switch services may be unavailable or slow.
Every financial operation must be auditable and support controlled investigation and reversal.
Sensitive personal and financial data must be protected and access must be least-privilege.
The design must remain provider-neutral until physical technology selection.
Architecture changes require human approval and traceability.

candidateTargetsRequiringConfirmation.requiredEvidence: business criticality, maintenance policy and service tier
journey boundary, percentile, load, network and external dependency assumptions
business impact assessment and recovery tier

functionalNeeds: Authenticate agents and authorize permitted operations.
Enforce limits, fees, liquidity and fraud policies.
Handle timeout, uncertainty, reversal and compensation.
Provide immutable audit and observability evidence.
